name: Latin Fuego Food Truck
address: 12005 SW 129th Ct, Miami, FL 33186, United States
address_source: Google Business Profile (gmaps_detail.js live read). The truck appears to be regularly parked at this lot next to a hand car wash (confirmed by a Google Maps photo showing the truck parked beside a 'Hand Car Wash & Detailing' sign at the same cross street feel), consistent with reviews describing visiting 'this food truck' rather than a delivery-only operation.
phone_source: Google Business Profile (gmaps_detail.js), and the exact same number is printed on the truck's own trailer wrap ('CATERING PARA EVENTOS 786-656-9977'), visible in a real Google Maps photo (gmaps-4.jpg).
has_own_site_evidence: Google Business Profile website field is empty (raw snippet shows 'Add website'). WebSearch for "Latin fuego" food truck Miami website/email/facebook found no official site; only a third-party aggregator (atly.com/location/LatinFuegoFoodTruck) which itself lists no website, confirmed via WebFetch (no site, no email, no social links, only Uber Eats / DoorDash ordering links, which are third-party platforms and do not count as an own website).

social_media.evidence: The Instagram handle '@latinfuego_foodtruck' is printed directly on the truck's own trailer wrap graphic, visible in a verified real Google Maps photo (gmaps-4.jpg), next to the phone number and the 'CATERING PARA EVENTOS' tagline. Not independently confirmed as a live, publicly browsable profile (Instagram blocks unauthenticated fetches), but it is the business's own self-published handle on its own signage, the same standard used elsewhere in this batch when a handle appears on a business's own branding.

email_search_note: Deep search performed, no public email found: Google Business Profile (no email field), WebSearch for the business name plus 'email'/'website'/'facebook', the atly.com third-party aggregator page (fetched via WebFetch, explicitly confirmed no email listed), and no Facebook page was found to check an About section. Consistent with FORGE-BRIEF's observation that home-service and food-truck type businesses rarely publish email; phone and Instagram DM are the real channels here.

google_business.hours: 12 PM to 10 PM, every day (live Google Business Profile status)

services_source: Truck's own trailer-wrap menu graphic (photographed, gmaps-4.jpg): lists 'Arroz Chaufa Con Camarones', 'Fideos Salteados', 'Pollo y Vegetales' and 'Lomo Saltado' by name, plus 'CATERING PARA EVENTOS'. No prices are printed anywhere (truck signage, Google photos, or the atly.com aggregator), consistent with the 'variante adaptada' rule: menu items are real and verbatim, pricing uses a call-for-pricing framing, never an invented number.

signature: Lomo Saltado (wok-tossed beef, onion, tomato, fries, rice)
chaufa: Arroz Chaufa con Camarones (shrimp fried rice)
Arroz Chaufa mixto/pollo (chicken or mixed fried rice, per photographed dishes)
noodles: Fideos Salteados (stir-fried noodles with chicken and vegetables)
other: Chicharrón de Pollo (fried chicken chicharron, per photographed dish)
catering: Catering para Eventos: bodas, cumpleaños, oficinas (per truck signage 'CATERING PARA EVENTOS')

reviews_verbatim.name: Yamal Diaz
reviews_verbatim.text: Absolutely amazing experience. The food was fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with care and quality ingredients. Every bite was delicious and perfectly prepared. The portions were generous and definitely worth the price.

reviews_verbatim.name: Mayelin Dieguez
reviews_verbatim.text: Excellent experience. The food was delicious, and the quality of the ingredients was evident. Perfect for coming with friends or family, and the service was attentive and fast. It's definitely a place I would return to and highly recommend.

reviews_verbatim.name: Maria Carla
reviews_verbatim.text: I found out this place opened recently and went. Everything was delicious, the food tasted amazing, the service was excellent, super friendly and they explained everything to me. They have great deals and prices, I will definitely keep visiting them.

reviews_verbatim.name: Laura Gonzalez
reviews_verbatim.text: Today was my first time visiting and I can tell you I was delighted. The food was spectacular, everything was top-notch. I definitely recommend it and I'll be back soon! Thank you!

curation_note: All 10 unique photos from the Google Business Profile (gmaps_photocycle.js, 25-step cycle, 11 URLs returned, 1 exact duplicate removed by md5 before review) were real, well-lit, non-graphic, no text/caption overlays added by anyone other than the truck's own factory signage, no selfies or mid-procedure shots. All 10 were used (across hero/experience/gallery); none needed to be rejected on quality grounds.
brand_vibe: Fire-and-flame branding taken directly from the truck's own trailer wrap (red-orange flame graphic with gold-yellow type). Built on templates/dark-v2 with a custom flame palette: accent-deep #d6480f (vivid flame red-orange), accent-mid #f2a33d (golden flame orange), warm near-black background #150d08. Distinct from other fire/warm palettes already used this batch (crimson, amber-brown, burnt-orange) by leaning into a brighter red-to-gold gradient matching the real truck art.
